inputs.text: This is being framed as a grassroots fight over water, but the real story is who gets to shape the rules before anyone sees the full picture. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is pushing a petition that calls on Alberta’s government to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration…”—and the message conveniently cuts off before the proposal is even complete. That kind of selective framing makes me suspicious: whatever interests are involved, the public is being steered toward a slogan while the details stay out of view.

subtopics: Public access to the complete proposal
